name: bookleaf-support-portal
description: Author support and communication portal for BookLeaf Publishing

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix frontend
